scope: Actual complete Classic/Feyz Chromium app, exact served bytes, native CDP touch/pan and hit tests. Synthetic device speech; no physical Android/audio guarantee.

checks.name: complete Classic/Feyz app and native touch initialize without SRI errors
trusted native tab taps reveal the selected section in its first view
an internal nontrusted tab click leaves the viewport position unchanged
native vertical pan on #r920Counter changes no count; next tap counts exactly once
native vertical pan on #r920Plus changes no count; next tap counts exactly once
the direct reading button reveals its selected original reading
direct reading and tools section buttons reveal their native disclosures
a new native pan cancels an older reveal queued behind the interaction gate
Tefekkür keeps native pan in its sole tab scrollport and exit remains clickable
Details has its own native scrollport above the scrim and its close button responds
every observed release asset keeps its exact tested bytes and no runtime/SRI errors occur
